whatItMustContain.title: What a Free Receipt Maker Slip Must Contain

items.title: Merchant Information and Tax ID
items.description: Trading name, business address, email, phone number, and tax registration number (such as GSTIN, VAT, or EIN).

items.title: Buyer / Customer Name
items.description: Full legal name or corporate entity name of the person or business who made the payment.

items.title: Unique Receipt Number and Date
items.description: A sequential receipt number and the exact calendar date payment was received [Verify with official source: commercial bookkeeping record retention rules].

items.title: Clear Itemized Description
items.description: Specific description of goods delivered or services rendered, including quantities and unit prices.

items.title: Payment Method and Reference ID
items.description: Payment mode (Credit Card, Cash, Bank Transfer, or UPI) and any transaction authorization code.

items.title: Remaining Balance Paid ($0.00)
items.description: Explicit confirmation that the bill has been settled in full with no outstanding balance remaining.

faq.title: Online Receipt Generator FAQs
faq.subtitle: Common questions regarding receipt types, PDF exports, and data privacy.

items.question: What is the difference between an invoice and a receipt?
items.answer: An invoice requests payment for pending goods or services, while a receipt provides formal proof that payment has already been received. You send an invoice prior to settlement with agreed credit terms like Net 15 or Net 30. Conversely, you issue a receipt through our online receipt generator immediately after funds clear to verify transaction settlement.

items.question: What must an official receipt include to serve as valid proof of payment?
items.answer: An official receipt must clearly state the business name, transaction date, unique receipt number, itemized goods or services, payment method, and total amount paid. It should also indicate any sales tax collected, the payment status as paid in full, and reference the original invoice number if applicable. This ensures seamless bookkeeping and expense deduction compliance for your customer.

items.question: Is this online receipt generator completely free with no watermarks?
items.answer: Yes, our receipt maker online free is 100% free with absolutely no watermarks, hidden paywalls, or account registrations required. You can generate a receipt online in seconds, itemize retail purchases or client payments, and export crisp, professional PDF receipts without subscription fees. All features remain unrestricted and private for all business types.

items.question: Can I generate a cash receipt with custom business details?
items.answer: Yes, our cash receipt generator lets you document cash, cheque, bank transfer, card, and digital wallet payments with ease. You can specify the exact payment method received, date of tender, customer name, and itemized subtotal. The tool formats your receipt cleanly for immediate printout or digital PDF distribution to your customer.

items.question: Can I add my company logo to the receipts I create?
items.answer: Yes, our receipt creator free includes built-in logo uploading so you can customize every receipt with your corporate brand. Simply upload your PNG or JPEG logo file from your computer or phone. Your graphic is processed locally in memory and rendered sharply on the receipt letterhead without leaving your device.

items.question: Do you store my customer transaction details or receipt drafts?
items.answer: No, we never store or track customer receipts, transaction records, or payment details on any remote server. All processing runs locally in your web browser. Receipt drafts remain saved strictly in your device local browser memory for convenience, ensuring complete confidentiality for your accounting data and client interactions.
